Travel allowance of €0,23 per kilometer. A 12-month contract with prospects of a permanent position. Working within an international and innovative company. Functieomschrijving As a CNC Turner, you will be responsible for independently preparing and carrying out various machining operations. You will work from technical drawings and ensure that every component meets the required quality and dimensional specifications. Our client works according to the high-mix, low-volume principle. Your main responsibilities will include: Independently setting up, changing over and operating 5-axis CNC lathes. Loading, checking and adjusting CNC programmes where necessary. Determining the appropriate workholding methods, tools and machining sequence. Machining components according to technical drawings and specifications. Checking dimensions and quality, identifying deviations and making adjustments where necessary.
